question.text: The processes of calcination and roasting in metallurgical industries, respectively, can lead to :

options.text: Photochemical smog and ozone layer depletion

solution.text: In Calcination and roasting <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CO</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>SO</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> are released which are responsible for Global warning and acid rain.
